rules.title: San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance – criminal history in affordable housing decisions
rules.requirement: Protects applicants and residents with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions. This page does not describe the specific limits on how housing providers may use that history.
rules.coverage_conditions: Affordable housing decisions in San Francisco that involve people with arrest or conviction history.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies to affordable housing; the page does not define which properties qualify.

rules.quoted_span: San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance protects residents with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions.
rules.conflict_note: The source is a summary link on the HRC landing page. It gives no official code citation, effective date, or detailed requirements, and the scope is described only as affordable housing.
